item.text: I’m reading the supplied v1 contract, assigned peer task, and current backend workspace before proposing the next revision.
The v1 contract is `GET /items` with item id/name fields. I’m proposing the next revision with an optional cursor and explicit `next_cursor` pagination metadata.
Revision `01a07db5d1d815e1366689fc303b84b0` is accepted. I’m updating the backend workspace to expose the cursor-aware endpoint and typed paginated response.
The mediated check rejected the first candidate, so I’m inspecting the persisted workspace and accepted contract to align the implementation with the checker before retrying.
